blurb: Unique in Toronto - when you sign up for lessons (CanSail 1 and 2) with us you become a Mooredale member for no extra cost. You get so much more for the price of a beginner sailing course at Mooredale -- you join a sailing community and have use of all our facilities and boats! You also join Toronto’s Albacore racing fleet, one of the largest for top-notch one-design sailboat racing in North America.
